name: EL CID Country Club Guest Discovery Agent
description: Read-only discovery for EL CID Country Club stays, independent studio, restaurant, pool, terraces, tennis, outdoor routes and booking/contact options in Benidoleig, Marina Alta, Alicante. It never creates or changes a reservation.

skills.name: Discover EL CID Country Club
skills.description: Return factual public information about EL CID as a country-club hospitality property with guest rooms, independent studio, restaurant and outdoor spaces.
examples: pool and restaurant stay in Marina Alta

skills.name: Find a cycling or hiking base
skills.description: Explain EL CID's fit as a Benidoleig base for hiking, cycling and days between Marina Alta mountain routes and the Mediterranean coast.
examples: where to stay for hiking in Marina Alta
quiet active weekend between mountain and sea

skills.name: Explore a private gathering
skills.description: Describe the published combination of accommodation, food and outdoor spaces for a considered private gathering and route the user to direct contact for capacity and service confirmation.
examples: weekend for family and friends near Denia
small group stay with restaurant and pool

skills.name: Find booking and contact routes
skills.description: Return EL CID's public Booking.com, WhatsApp, phone and email routes without creating or modifying a reservation or inventing a discount.
